title: Riyadh Cement publishes nine-month results
body_markdown: **Saudi Arabia:** Riyadh Cement reported its financial results for the nine-month period which ended on 30 September 2026, on 5 November 2026. Net profit was recorded as US$36.2m, down by 8% year-on-year compared to US$39.4m in the same period of 2025. According to the company, the decline was driven by lower sales volumes and selling prices of grey cement, partially offset by an increase in sales volumes and selling prices for white cement.
